title: Vanilla Skies
description: A classic Vanilla Skyblock experience with a fun grind and extra progression. Start on your island, collect resources, complete quests, earn SkyCoins, and unlock cool cosmetic rewards like tags, pets and trails. The server keeps the core Skyblock feel.
body:
🌴 **Vanilla Skyblock**

A classic Vanilla Skyblock experience with extra progression, quests, cosmetics, and unique features!
Start on a small island, expand your base, build farms, grind resources, and turn nothing into something huge.🌍

✨ **Features** ✨

📜 **Quests** - Complete progression-based goals that help guide your gameplay, give you rewards, and provide new milestones to work toward as your island grows.

💰 **SkyCoins** - Earn currency through chat games (currently the only way to get SkyCoins for now), then save up to unlock cosmetics and other fun rewards over time.

🏷️ **Chat Tags** - Unlock cosmetic chat tags to customize your look in chat, show off your progress, and stand out from other players.

🐾 **Cosmetics** - Enjoy cosmetic-only rewards with more content coming soon, including pets, extra tags, and other fun ways to flex your progress.

🧺 **Scav** - Search chests and barrels at spawn to find loot, useful items, and fun surprises for an extra activity outside normal island grinding.

♨️ **Hot Spring** - Stand in the Hot Spring and click the water to get loot and buffs, giving you a fun interactive activity with useful rewards while you hang out.

🎲 **Lucky Blocks** - Get Lucky Blocks by mining stone or cobblestone, adding an extra surprise reward system to your normal grinding and generator mining.

✅ Vanilla feel
✅ Progression-focused
✅ Cosmetic rewards (no unfair advantages)

Build. Grind. Progress. Flex. 🔥
